V. CONCLUSION
While the majority of stereo matching algorithms focus
on achieving high accuracy on still images, the volume of
research aimed at recovery of temporally consistent disparity
maps remains disproportionally small. This paper introduces
an efficient temporal cost aggregation scheme that can easily
be combined with conventional spatial cost aggregation to
improve the accuracy of stereo matching when operating on
video sequences. A synthetic video sequence, along with
